entries.subject: Cassini ISS frames with 2018 shape-release cameras
entries.finding: [PDS Cassini calibrated imagery](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/calibration.html) and the camera geometry in the [2018 shape release](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/cassini/saturn_satellite_shape_models_V1_0/) supply the photographs. Complementary viewpoints provide observed coverage without fabricating the far side.

entries.subject: Cassini frame N1866366469_1
entries.finding: Cassini `n1866366469_1` is dominated by cast shadow and contributes less than 0.04% unique valid map coverage in the 512 × 256 source comparison. Its unstable isolated samples are omitted; the remaining five views retain the useful observed terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: A shadow-free view or finer processing adds usable unique coverage.

entries.subject: Voyager/Stooke photomosaics and drawings as the main map
entries.finding: Legacy Voyager/Stooke photomosaics and shaded-relief drawings in the [Stooke map archive](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds3/multi_mission/MULTI_SA_MULTI_6_STOOKEMAPS_V3_0/document/00_map_guide.html) are not the main map: the selected Cassini frames offer finer source detail with explicit registration to this shape, and drawings are not observational textures.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered observational map finer than the Cassini frames is released.

entries.subject: Additional clear-filter coverage and a second IR3/GRN/UV3 sequence
entries.finding: Clear frames N1864500586_1 and N1649345705_1 expand Monochrome coverage from 64.1% to 69.2%. The December 2015 IR3 N1828124265_1, GRN N1828122367_1 and UV3 N1828122742_1 sequence expands False color from 4.1% to 26.6%. Fitted translations and roll pass independent fixed-camera feature checks; released directions, ranges and focal scale are retained. Original acquisition lighting remains, and current-main browser qualification is pending.

entries.subject: Separate 2017 southern IR3/GRN/UV3 candidate
entries.finding: N1866367060_1, N1866366919_1 and N1866366996_1 were tried but did not yield enough independent image features for registration. Omitting them leaves the accepted December 2015 expansion at 26.6% coverage. They are not included.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent control points qualify these frames without weakening the registration criteria.

entries.subject: Selected calibrated Cassini filter-color observations
entries.finding: The original 2017 IR3/GRN/UV3 close sequence and the independently checked 2015 sequence recorded separately in the coverage entry supply False color. Each filter uses its own camera and only common valid coverage; observed fringes and acquisition shadows remain.
